items.title: Functions of the Lymphatic System (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Functions of the Lymphatic System: a main subheading of 11.5 Lymphatic system of human, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 254-255.

blocks.text: Lymphatic system zaid (izafi) mayah, ghule hue proteins aur doosri cheezein wapas khoon mein lata hai. Ek aam insan mein roz taqreeban teen litre mayah blood capillaries se zyada nikalta hai (jitna wapas jata hai us se zyada). Yeh mayah lymphatic capillaries jazb kar leti hain aur dil tak pohanchne se pehle khoon mein wapas daal deti hain. Lymphatic system jism ko bahar se aane wale dushmanon (germs) se bachane mein bhi madad karta hai. Lymph nodes lymph ko chhaante (filter karte) hain. In mein lymphocytes aur macrophages hote hain jo lymph mein maujood bacteria aur viruses ko khatam karte hain. Tilli (spleen) apne macrophages aur lymphocytes se khoon ko chhaanti hai; yeh bahar ke zarrat aur purane RBCs ko khatam karte hain. Tilli RBCs ko zakhira (store) bhi karti hai.
